title: Red Hat Security Advisory: c-ares security update
description: Two denial of service vulnerabilities have been identified in the c-ares C library, which provides asynchronous DNS requests and name resolving APIs. The first vulnerability (CVE-2026-69186) involves unvalidated DNS header record counts, and the second (CVE-2026-69184) involves CPU exhaustion via unbounded DNS name compression pointer chains. These issues can cause denial of service conditions. Red Hat has released security updates for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 to address these vulnerabilities.
